'''Lucid''' is a large map for 4on4 TDM. The layout of the map is based from two other maps that are merged into one, [[Loco]] and [[Terran]], which are two earlier maps designed by {{player|alice|flag=se}}. However the layout is changed in multiple ways together with the item placements. The core of the two maps only have one passage between them, at this center area all powerups are placed. The key areas of the map to control are the far sides of the two sections of the map, where red and yellow armors are placed, together with the two rocket launchers.
